title: E212: Add "imsi" tap and IMSI List dialog
description:
Add a new "imsi" tap to the E.212 dissector that fires for every
valid IMSI association. The tap validates IMSI strings (5-15 digits,
all numeric) before queuing to filter out garbage from broken
session lookups.

New features:
- Wireshark: Telephony → IMSI List dialog showing all unique IMSIs
  in a capture with packet count, first/last frame, and protocols.
  Double-click applies display filter for that IMSI. Multi-select
  with "Prepare Filter" combines multiple IMSIs.
- tshark: -z imsi statistics prints the same table to stdout.

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2

changes_data.diff:
@@ -88,6 +88,15 @@ See the “New and Updated Features” section below for more details.
 
 The following features are either new or have been significantly updated since version 4.6.0:
 
+* New IMSI List dialog (menu:Telephony[IMSI List]) scans all packets in a capture and lists
+  every unique IMSI with packet count, first/last frame, and protocols.
+  Double-click an IMSI to apply a display filter for that subscriber.
+  Multi-select and "Prepare Filter" combines multiple IMSIs.
+
+* New `tshark -z imsi` statistics lists all unique IMSIs found in a capture
+  with packet counts, first/last frame numbers, and protocols.
+  A new "imsi" tap is registered by the E.212 dissector.
+
 * The Windows installers now ship with Npcap 1.88.
   They previously shipped with Npcap 1.83.
